fact: The INS reports that in 2023 it collected administrative enterprise sources (tax directorate DGI, the business one-stop shop GUCE, CPCC, FEC and the commercial courts) to update the 2019 enterprise census database, and in September 2026 sought a consultant to design a permanent digital system for transmitting administrative data from those services to the INS.
title: Termes de référence - Assistance technique à la transformation numérique de l'INS
publisher: Projet TRANSFORME, Ministère de l'Entrepreneuriat et du Développement des PME
